entities.name: Segovia
entities.description: Plane where everything exists in miniature at about 1:100 scale; has land and underwater cities.

entities.name: Segovian Leviathan
entities.description: Largest creature on Segovia, about the size of a Dominarian elephant.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who once visited Segovia and noted its aquatic nature.

entities.name: Phyrexian centurion
entities.description: Invader of Segovia who did not shrink via the omenpath.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Artifact whose omenpath was used to reach Segovia.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Segovia was invaded.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas visits Segovia and notes its vastly aquatic nature.
events.quote: It was once visited by Nicol Bolas

events.summary: A Phyrexian centurion invades Segovia via Realmbreaker's omenpath without shrinking.
events.quote: Segovia was invaded by at least one Phyrexian centurion
